variable_coverage.construction: RET_SUPP_t: The supplier’s two-day market-adjusted stock return on the day of and day following its customer’s QEA, measured as the supplier’s raw return minus the value-weighted market return on each day. The paper does not state whether the two daily adjusted returns are summed, compounded, or otherwise aggregated. The source does not specify an exact formula. Raw inputs and limitations are recorded in the linked requirements.

RET_CUST_t: Two-day market-adjusted stock return of the customer on the day of and the day following its own QEA; measured using the customer’s raw return minus the value-weighted market return on each day. The source does not specify an exact formula. Raw inputs and limitations are recorded in the linked requirements.

CORR_t: Pearson correlation in the supplier’s and customer’s daily market-adjusted returns over the year immediately preceding the customer’s QEA; this is normal, non-event-period return correlation. Formula: PearsonCorr(daily market-adjusted returns_supplier, daily market-adjusted returns_customer; preceding year). Raw inputs and limitations are recorded in the linked requirements.

PCT_SALES_t: Percentage of the supplier’s annual sales made to the customer in the fiscal year before the customer’s QEA. Formula: supplier annual sales to customer / supplier total annual sales (percentage). Raw inputs and limitations are recorded in the linked requirements.

RET_CUST_t × CORR_t: Product of (The customer’s two-day market-adjusted stock return on the day of and day following its QEA, measured as daily raw return minus the value-weighted market return; the paper does not state how the two daily adjusted returns are aggregated.) and (The Pearson correlation between supplier and customer daily market-adjusted returns over the year immediately before the customer’s QEA; this is normal, non-event-period return correlation.). Formula: RET_CUST_t × CORR_t. Raw inputs and limitations are recorded in the linked requirements.

RET_CUST_t × PCT_SALES_t: Product of (The customer’s two-day market-adjusted stock return on the day of and day following its QEA, measured as daily raw return minus the value-weighted market return; the paper does not state how the two daily adjusted returns are aggregated.) and (The percentage of the supplier’s annual sales made to the customer in the fiscal year preceding that customer’s QEA; the source does not state whether the stored measure is a fraction or is multiplied by 100.). Formula: RET_CUST_t × PCT_SALES_t. Raw inputs and limitations are recorded in the linked requirements.

CORR_t × PCT_SALES_t: Product of (The Pearson correlation between supplier and customer daily market-adjusted returns over the year immediately before the customer’s QEA; this is normal, non-event-period return correlation.) and (The percentage of the supplier’s annual sales made to the customer in the fiscal year preceding that customer’s QEA; the source does not state whether the stored measure is a fraction or is multiplied by 100.). Formula: CORR_t × PCT_SALES_t. Raw inputs and limitations are recorded in the linked requirements.

RET_CUST_t × CORR_t × PCT_SALES_t: Product of (The customer’s two-day market-adjusted stock return on the day of and day following its QEA, measured as daily raw return minus the value-weighted market return; the paper does not state how the two daily adjusted returns are aggregated.), (The Pearson correlation between supplier and customer daily market-adjusted returns over the year immediately before the customer’s QEA; this is normal, non-event-period return correlation.), and (The percentage of the supplier’s annual sales made to the customer in the fiscal year preceding that customer’s QEA; the source does not state whether the stored measure is a fraction or is multiplied by 100.). Formula: RET_CUST_t × CORR_t × PCT_SALES_t. Raw inputs and limitations are recorded in the linked requirements.

implementation_issues.description: The paper does not state whether the two daily market-adjusted returns are summed, compounded, or otherwise aggregated into the two-day RET_SUPP/RET_CUST measure.
